# wizard-download-container-network — analysis (generated by analyst on 2026-08-10; revised 2026-08-10 per change note)

**Revision note.** The user's change note (2026-08-10, supersedes the original
brief's scope question) makes the image-BUILD legs IN SCOPE of this family: the
product stance is that a first-time user must be able to run ONLY the shell
scripts to set everything up — no user ever edits docker/DNS/host config
manually. The draft set's "follow-up candidate" disposition of the build legs
is withdrawn; M1-810 is filed. The revision also carries three verified driver
probes (this host, 2026-08-10) that correct the draft's "Runtime implication
(ASSUMPTION)" paragraph: compose-network SERVICE containers are UNAFFECTED
(their embedded DNS forwards to the host's 127.0.0.53 stub — verified
`ExtServers: [host(127.0.0.53)]`; `docker exec
infochat-test-infochat-collector-1 getent hosts huggingface.co` resolves), so
runtime egress and `ollama pull` WORK on the divergent host class; the broken
class is exactly the default-bridge one-shot containers — the download
throwaways AND the image-BUILD containers (M1-797's build died on this exact
wall and was worked around with `docker build --network=host`, local memory
entry). Family END state after M1-808 + M1-809 + M1-810: NO repo-launched
container depends on default-bridge DNS, and the daemon.json host remedy
becomes optional residue, not a setup-path requirement.

## Problem

The setup wizard's `/image` step (prod/scripts/4b-image.sh, mode=local) passes
ALL five preflight HEAD checks and the disk/memory checks, then crashes on the
very first download (user report 2026-08-10, reproduced on this host the same
day — brief probes 1–3):

```
+ HEAD https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/resolve/main/diffusion_models/krea2_turbo_int8_convrot.safetensors
... (all five HEADs pass)
+ download https://huggingface.co/.../krea2_turbo_int8_convrot.safetensors -> infochat-comfyui-models/diffusion_models/...
curl: (6) Could not resolve host: huggingface.co
Warning: Problem : timeout. Will retry in 1 seconds. 3 retries left.
... (retries exhaust, wizard dies mid-download)
```

The operator is left with a cryptic curl error and no hint that container DNS
is the cause. The user's driving question: "is this an issue a user will face
when he tries to set up the app? if so it is broken and we need to fix it — we
cannot expect a user to run around and figure out how to fix it."

**Answer (verified): YES, it is broken for a general class of network
environments, and by construction, not by accident.** The preflight runs HOST
curl (4b-image.sh:522), but the download runs curl INSIDE a one-shot
default-bridge container (4b-image.sh:594 — no `--network` flag anywhere in
prod/, grep-verified). Wherever the host's network path and the container's
bridge network path diverge — VPN DNS splits, rootless-daemon resolver quirks,
corporate proxies/firewalls — the preflight validates a path the download
never uses: it passes, and the download dies.

**The same wall stands on every image build the scripts launch** (change note,
census below): a first-time user on the divergent host class who clears steps
4/4b thanks to M1-808 dies at step 7 (7-apps.sh:62 `docker compose build`)
and, on a fresh GPU host, at 4b's implicit comfyui image build
(4b-image.sh:801 `up -d --force-recreate` with the image absent) — and the
same explicit `compose build` shape recurs in restore.sh:695 (host-clone
restore) and upgrade.sh:155,272 (rebuild + rollback rebuild). Image BUILD
containers are default-bridge class (change-note fact 2; M1-797's build died
on DNS on this host — local memory entry).

Verified mechanism on this host (rootless docker; systemd-resolved stub
127.0.0.53 with DNS-over-TLS to Mullvad resolvers):

- Default-bridge one-shot containers receive a copy of
  /run/systemd/resolve/resolv.conf ("legacy", nameserver 194.242.2.2), which
  answers plain UDP/53 with ZERO answer records from this network (ancount=0
  for 194.242.2.2; ancount=4 for 192.168.0.1, 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8 — brief
  probes, 2026-08-10).
- `docker run --rm curlimages/curl:8.11.1 -sI --max-time 8 https://huggingface.co`
  → fails, no resolve (bridge network).
- `docker run --rm --network host curlimages/curl:8.11.1 -sI --max-time 8 https://huggingface.co`
  → HTTP/2 200.
- Compose-network SERVICE containers are unaffected (change-note fact 1):
  their embedded DNS forwards to the host's 127.0.0.53 stub (container
  /etc/resolv.conf: "ExtServers: [host(127.0.0.53)]"); `docker exec
  infochat-test-infochat-collector-1 getent hosts huggingface.co` resolves.
  Runtime egress (Collector feed fetches, remote-LLM calls) and `ollama pull`
  therefore WORK on the divergent host class — the draft analysis's "Runtime
  implication (ASSUMPTION)" paragraph was wrong where it implied runtime
  egress fails, and is corrected here.

## Root cause

**Structural path divergence between the host network path and the
default-bridge container network path, hit by every repo-launched container
that runs OUTSIDE a compose network.** Two proven instances of one class:

1. **Downloads.** The wizard's reachability evidence (host curl HEAD) is
   gathered on one network path, and the multi-GB download executes on a
   different one (one-shot container, default bridge, daemon-provided DNS).
   The two paths share nothing by construction: different network namespace,
   different resolver config (a copy of /run/systemd/resolve/resolv.conf →
   194.242.2.2 on this host, answering zero records), different proxy
   environment (the container receives none). Proven: brief probes 1–3 on
   this host, 2026-08-10 (bridge fails resolution / `--network host` returns
   HTTP/2 200; ancount=0 from the container's assigned resolver). Proven for
   the 4b leg by direct reproduction; the 4-llm/restore legs use the
   byte-identical invocation shape, so the mechanism transfers without a
   separate live probe.
2. **Builds.** Image BUILD containers are default-bridge class (change-note
   fact 2): every `RUN` step that fetches (mvn, apt-get, pip, curl) resolves
   through the same broken resolver copy. Proven on this host at M1-797 time
   (build died on DNS; `docker build --network=host` workaround — local
   memory entry) and carried as driver-verified for the compose-build shape
   (change-note fact 2, 2026-08-10).

The flaw is the unstated premise that "the host's network works" implies "a
default-bridge container's network works." Compose-network SERVICE containers
do NOT share the flaw — their embedded DNS forwards to the host resolver stub
(verified) — which is why runtime egress and `ollama pull` work and why the
fix scope is exactly the one-shot download containers and the build
containers.

Residual (flagged for implementation, does not block): the exact breadth of
the rootful-docker variant (no rootful divergent host available to probe) —
the fix does not depend on it, because host-network parity holds in both
daemon modes (rootless `--network host` shares the daemon's/user's netns —
probe-verified; rootful shares the host netns by definition); and the exact
compose version floor for `build.network` (P11).

## Pitfalls

- **P1 — A preflight that tests a different path than the download is a
  false pass (and the mirror trap: a preflight stricter than the download
  path is a false abort).** This IS the defect. Lineage: M1-390's false-pass
  hazard ("a missing `ss` is silently treated as 'port free'",
  0-doctor.sh:96-103 — "reported unverifiable, never silently passed").
  Consequence for the fix: after M1-808 moves the download to the host path,
  host-curl preflight is same-path and honest; M1-809's new 4-llm.sh
  preflight must run on that same path, and must not abort on evidence weaker
  than a network-path failure (see P10). The `ollama pull` leg gets NO host
  preflight: the pull runs on the compose network (verified WORKING on the
  divergent host class — change-note fact 1), so a host-curl HEAD would test
  a path the pull does not use — the P1 false-pass shape in the other
  direction.
- **P2 — The fetch mechanics are load-bearing controls, not incidental
  syntax.** The download invocations carry: `-u 0:0` (fresh named volume is
  root-owned — 4-llm.sh:225-229), argv-only no-shell containers (M1-394
  injection posture — 4-llm.sh:213-218), SHA-256 enforced + mismatch-rm
  (4-llm.sh:232-241), skip-if-present dedupe (4-llm.sh:221, 4b-image.sh:587),
  `--retry 3 --create-dirs` on the 4b download (4b-image.sh:594, the
  M1-798 handoff's HF-stall retry loop), pinned CURL_IMAGE (M1-004).
  Engineering-rules §10: a diff that reroutes these paths must carry every
  control across; LlamacppWiringTest.fetchGgufWritesToTheVolumeComposeMounts
  (:307-322) pins the `-v` volume argument and must stay green.
- **P3 — restore.sh's fetch_gguf is a verbatim twin with a sync obligation.**
  restore.sh:226-244 duplicates 4-llm.sh's function (comment :222-225; the
  `docker run` download line is byte-identical) and the header obligates
  lock-step constants (:51-58). Fixing only 4-llm.sh leaves host-clone
  restore (§7.10.1) dying of the same defect on the same host class; fixing
  it DIFFERENTLY breaks the stated sync contract.
- **P4 — The fake-docker shim must capture, not no-op (the M1-442 lesson).**
  M1-442 shipped a non-functional service because the drive layer no-opped
  the `-v` argument (M1-442 acceptance item 4). Today's shims exit 0 for the
  `ls` probe, so the download invocation is NEVER issued under test
  (LlamacppWiringTest.java:421; RestoreWiringTest's run branch has the same
  shape). A `--network host` assertion that only ever sees `ls` argv pins
  nothing — the test must make the download invocation observable (volume
  probe reports absent → download issued → argv recorded) WITHOUT weakening
  any existing assertion (§8 test-modification authorization must be explicit
  in the ticket).
- **P5 — Host-network widening must stay inside the posture that makes it
  sound (security.md §Trust boundaries).** `--network host` / `build:
  network: host` puts the container in the host's netns — it can reach
  host-loopback services (postgres 127.0.0.1:5432 — which is UP during
  restore.sh:695's and upgrade.sh's builds). Sound HERE because: (a) the
  download container is a transient argv-only curl client against a pinned
  image (M1-004) that binds no port, and the build container is a transient
  whose entire content is repo-committed Dockerfile source the operator
  already trusts to run at all — §Trust boundaries items 6–8 govern SERVICES
  that expose unauthenticated ports (security.md:62-95), and neither widens
  one; (b) the download URLs are curated constants or operator-entered at
  setup — the operator is the threat-model principal at this surface and can
  run the same curl directly on the host, so no privilege is escalated (same
  reasoning as M1-394's operator-trusted TLS fetch and M1-744 redteam's
  out-of-model disposition of opt-in operator actions). A change that gives
  these containers a shell, a listening port, or an unpinned image voids the
  argument — as would moving a SERVICE to host networking at runtime
  (network_mode), which stays forbidden.
- **P6 — Message honesty, calibrated to the family END state (both
  directions).** After the family lands, downloads AND builds use the host's
  own network path, and NO repo-launched container depends on default-bridge
  DNS (change-note fact 3). Failure text that blames "container DNS" for a
  download or build failure is a spec-truthness failure (the failing path IS
  the host path); text that points at daemon DNS as a setup-path requirement
  is equally wrong (optional residue after M1-810, not a requirement).
  Intermediate-state discipline: M1-809 lands BEFORE M1-810, so the download
  guidance must make NO claim about build legs — each ticket's text states
  only its own legs.
- **P7 — Retry/timeout semantics survive the reroute.** 4b's download carries
  `--retry 3 --create-dirs` (4b-image.sh:594); fetch_gguf has NO retry today.
  Keep exactly that: dropping `--retry 3` reopens HF-stall deaths; adding
  retry to fetch_gguf is unasked scope (§1).
- **P8 — Env forwarding must be `set -u`-safe.** The scripts run
  `set -euo pipefail` (design §7.7.2 behavior contract, 07-deployment.md:805).
  Proxy forwarding therefore uses the name-only `-e NAME` form: docker
  forwards the current value iff set in the wizard environment and silently
  omits unset names — never a `${VAR}` expansion (which `set -u` rejects for
  unset vars and which would forward an empty string instead of omitting).
- **P9 — The new mvn tests must stay hermetic.** The wizard-drive family runs
  offline (fake docker; SimpleXProvisioningWiringTest states the posture:
  "no containers, no daemon, no network"). M1-809's preflight runs curl —
  the tests must intercept it with a fake curl on PATH (same pattern as the
  fake docker) and must never issue a real query to huggingface.co from
  `mvn verify`.
- **P10 — HEAD semantics for operator-entered URLs: the preflight verifies
  the NETWORK PATH, not the asset.** 4b's curated HF URLs answer HEAD
  (probe-verified). 4-llm.sh custom-override URLs (M1-417 supported flow) may
  be hosted where HEAD is refused (405/403 → curl -I exit 22). Aborting a
  working custom URL on a HEAD refusal is the mirror false of P1 — a preflight
  lie in the other direction. Network-class exits (6 resolve / 7 connect /
  28 timeout) abort; an HTTP-level refusal WARNS and proceeds (the server
  answered, so the path is reachable; the download gets the real verdict).
- **P11 — The declarative build-network key has a compose version floor the
  repo does not currently gate.** The compose CLI exposes no per-invocation
  `build --network` flag (ASSUMPTION — analyst has no shell; implementor
  verifies against the repo's compose line), so the fix is the declarative
  `build: network: host` key — which entered the Compose Spec after plain v2.
  The repo's floor today is "any Compose v2" (0-doctor.sh:79-85;
  DoctorWiringTest's fake reports v2.20.0, DoctorWiringTest.java:56); the
  host runs v5.4.0 (change-note fact 2). A key the floor's compose REJECTS
  breaks every compose invocation against the file (worse than the defect);
  a key it silently IGNORES fixes nothing. The exact minimum version is a
  verification duty; if it exceeds the current gate, the doctor check gains a
  version floor with an actionable remedy (M1-439 accumulate-and-report
  style) in the same ticket.
- **P12 — Implicit builds are covered ONLY by the declarative shape.** A
  per-call-site flag fix would reach 7-apps.sh:62, upgrade.sh:155,272 and
  restore.sh:695 — and miss the builds compose performs IMPLICITLY at `up`
  time when the image is absent: 4b-image.sh:801 (the fresh-GPU-host path —
  exactly the first-time user the family promise names) and apps.sh:65. The
  declarative key is read by every compose-initiated build, explicit or
  implicit; call-site flags are not. This is the deciding argument between
  the two fix shapes the change note offered.
- **P13 — Build-failure honesty has four sites, including the rollback.**
  After M1-810 a build failure on the host path is a HOST-egress failure;
  guidance must say so (P6). The four explicit sites differ in shape:
  7-apps.sh:62 and restore.sh:695 are bare commands under `set -e` (need an
  if-wrap); upgrade.sh:272 already has an if-fail branch that rolls back
  (guidance joins the branch); upgrade.sh:155 is the ROLLBACK's own rebuild
  — a build failure there is catastrophic (rollback of a failed upgrade
  failing to build) and must not die cryptically either. Wraps must not
  change exit codes or ordering (RestoreWiringTest pins that no build argv
  follows a failed gate, :486-489).

## Solution options

**Option A (CHOSEN) — Downloads AND builds run on the host network path;
every download leg gets a same-path preflight; failures print actionable
guidance.** Two mechanics:

- Downloads: `--network host` on the three one-shot download invocations
  (+ name-only forwarding of the host's proxy env vars). Host-curl preflight
  and download then share one network path by construction; 4-llm.sh gains
  the preflight it never had; failure messages become actionable (M1-808,
  M1-809).
- Builds: declarative `build: network: host` in the three compose `build:`
  sections (docker-compose.yml collector + provider; docker-compose.comfyui.yml
  comfyui). One key per build block covers EVERY compose-initiated build —
  the four explicit `compose build` sites AND the implicit up-time builds
  (P12) — because compose reads the build config, not the call site (M1-810).

Spec grounding: design §7.7.2 wizard contract (bare host → running deployment
— 07-deployment.md:767; step 7 "Build both images" :800 and the 4b row :797
make builds part of the contracted path; preflight-with-actionable-remedy
:792) under the constraint of security.md §Trust boundaries (P5).
Cost/risk: argument-level script edits + one key per compose build block +
test pins; two security_relevant tickets (netns widening). Verified live on
the RED host for the download shape (brief probe 3) and for the build
mechanism (M1-797's `--network=host` workaround, local memory).

**Option B (REJECTED) — Fix container DNS at the daemon level (daemon.json
`"dns"`).** Requires host-config action outside the wizard plus a
rootless-daemon restart — exactly the "user runs around and figures it out"
outcome the user's stance rejects ("no user ever edits docker/DNS/host
config manually. Anything less is broken."); fixes only resolver
misconfiguration, not VPN splits, proxy divergence, or firewall classes;
cannot be enforced or verified by the repo. After M1-808 + M1-810 no
repo-launched container needs it (change-note fact 3): it is optional residue
for the operator's own non-repo containers, and this family does not even
document it in the setup path.

**Option C (REJECTED) — Preflight in the container context (bridge HEAD
probe) only.** Achieves fail-fast but not "work": on a divergent host the
operator still cannot download or build, now with an earlier error. Strictly
dominated by A.

**Option D (REJECTED) — Download with host curl everywhere (drop the
container).** The named-volume branch writes into a Docker named volume,
which has no stable host path across daemon modes (rootless volumes live
under the user's docker state dir); the container-write shape is the
established M1-442/M1-394 posture (argv-only, `-u 0:0`, SHA probes). A
host-curl-into-volume rewrite (docker cp or volume-path guessing) is a larger
change that breaks the injection posture and the restore.sh twin for no gain:
the container is not the defect — its network context is.

**Option E (REJECTED, build-leg shape) — An equivalent flag at each explicit
`compose build` call site.** Two fatal flaws, verified: (1) the compose CLI
exposes no per-invocation build `--network` flag (ASSUMPTION flagged for
implementor verification — the only flag shape exists on plain `docker
build`, which would mean abandoning `compose build` and hand-rolling image
tags at four sites — a structural rewrite, not a fix); (2) call-site flags
cannot reach the IMPLICIT up-time builds (4b-image.sh:801 fresh GPU host;
apps.sh:65) — P12. The declarative key has neither flaw.

## Chosen approach

Option A + E-rejected, decomposed into three tickets: M1-808 → M1-809 →
M1-810.

**Decision → spec_refs mapping:**

- Downloads on the host network path (M1-808): implements the design §7.7.2
  wizard contract (the setup path must actually reach "a running, verified
  deployment" — 07-deployment.md:767) under the constraint of security.md
  §Trust boundaries (P5 posture argument; no new exposed service).
- Proxy env forwarding (M1-808): same refs — "the host's network path"
  includes the host's proxy configuration; without it the fix leaves the
  explicit-proxy class divergent (brief names corporate proxies).
- Same-path preflight for the 4-llm.sh legs + download guidance text
  (M1-809): implements the design §7.7.2 preflight-with-actionable-remedy
  posture (07-deployment.md:792 step-0 row; :797 4b row) and the M1-798
  item-6 "abort before any download" commitment, extended to the step that
  lacks it.
- Builds on the host network path + build-failure guidance (M1-810):
  implements the SAME wizard contract for the step-7 build leg
  (07-deployment.md:767, :800 "Build both images") and the 4b implicit
  build (:797 row "bring up the docker-compose.comfyui.yml overlay"), under
  the same §Trust boundaries constraint (P5); the conditional doctor floor
  implements the step-0 preflight-with-actionable-remedy posture (:792) for
  the compose version the key requires (P11).

**Files to touch (across the family):** prod/scripts/4b-image.sh,
prod/scripts/4-llm.sh, prod/scripts/restore.sh, prod/scripts/7-apps.sh,
prod/scripts/upgrade.sh, (conditionally) prod/scripts/0-doctor.sh,
docker-compose.yml, docker-compose.comfyui.yml,
infochat-llm-adapter/.../wiring/LlamacppWiringTest.java,
infochat-provider/.../wiring/ (new build-network test; conditionally
DoctorWiringTest).

**Order and rationale:** M1-808 FIRST — it changes the network context the
downloads use; M1-809's parity claim ("the preflight tests the path the
download uses") is only true once the download is on the host path, and its
guidance text states that fact. M1-808 also extends the fake-docker shim so
the download invocation becomes observable (P4); M1-809 builds its fake-curl
seam on the same drive layer, so the shim extension is pre-authorized in
M1-808's test_plan and named as consumed in M1-809's. M1-810 LAST — its
guidance text states the family end state (downloads AND builds on the host
path; no repo-launched container on default-bridge DNS), which is true only
once both siblings have landed; the serial order also keeps the three
tickets off restore.sh simultaneously. M1-810's compose key does not
technically depend on M1-808/809, but its text does (P6 intermediate-state
discipline), and blocked_by expresses that.

## Controls to preserve (engineering-rules §10)

For every path the change reroutes (enumerated at analysis time, per §10 —
not improvised at implementation):

1. **fetch_gguf / fetch_asset download controls (M1-808):** `-u 0:0`
   root-write rationale (4-llm.sh:225-229); argv-only no-shell invocation
   (M1-394); pinned CURL_IMAGE (M1-004; 4-llm.sh:49, 4b-image.sh:37,
   restore.sh:65); skip-if-present probe staying NON-root (4-llm.sh:221,
   4b-image.sh:587); SHA-256 enforced + mismatch-rm (4-llm.sh:232-241,
   restore.sh:234-243); `--retry 3 --create-dirs` on the 4b download
   (4b-image.sh:594); volume name literals `infochat-llamacpp-models` /
   `infochat-comfyui-models` (M1-442 name-pin; docker-compose.comfyui.yml:68-72).
2. **Tests that pin them:** LlamacppWiringTest.fetchGgufWritesToTheVolumeComposeMounts
   (volume argument, :307-322) and the whole wizard-drive suite
   (props/secrets shapes :230-263, custom-URL persistence :265-286,
   remote-switch reconcile :324-357) must stay green; the shim change is
   authorized by M1-808's test_plan and may not weaken any of these.
   RestoreWiringTest's full gate suite stays green — in particular
   nonIgnorablePgRestoreErrorAbortsBeforeImageBuildAndBringUp (no build argv
   after a failed gate, :486-489) and sourceStoppedFlagReachesProviderStart
   (bring-up ordering, :553-572); the M1-810 wrap of restore.sh:695 must not
   move the build or change gate behavior.
3. **Preflight commitment:** M1-798 acceptance item 6 (HEAD every asset URL
   before any download; dead URL aborts) keeps its strict semantics for the
   curated 4b URLs — M1-809 changes the MESSAGE, not the gate.
4. **Resume mechanics:** a mid-download failure leaves the step unmarked in
   .setup-state (setup.sh:72-73 region; mark_done/is_done), so re-run
   resumes; skip-if-present plus (llamacpp) SHA re-verification make the
   resume safe. (Adjacent observation, NOT in scope: 4b's fetch_asset has no
   checksum, so a truncated safetensors would skip on re-run — pre-existing
   hazard; noted for the user, no ticket filed, §1.)
5. **Restore lock-step:** restore.sh's fetch_gguf and its failure text move
   with 4-llm.sh's (P3).
6. **Build-side controls (M1-810):** the compose build sections change ONLY
   by the `network: host` key — context/dockerfile lines stay
   (docker-compose.yml:96-98, :168-170); comfyui's `image:
   infochat-comfyui:rocm-gfx1151` pin survives (docker-compose.comfyui.yml:24);
   upgrade.sh's auto-rollback flow (:151-163) keeps its ordering and exit
   behavior — guidance wraps, never control-flow edits; 7-apps.sh's
   M1-392 attributable-build-phase shape (:53-60) stays a separate build
   phase; the M1-389 `--env-file` discipline on every compose call is
   untouched; no SERVICE gains `network_mode` (runtime host networking stays
   forbidden — P5).

## Verification strategy

- P1 → M1-809 reproduction test: fake curl exit 6 → wizard aborts non-zero
  BEFORE any docker argv is recorded (failure-mode: on main the script never
  consults curl and proceeds to download — test RED). Parity probe on the
  divergent host: preflight HEAD and the actual download both succeed over
  the host path (M1-808 item 5). The ollama-pull leg is asserted ABSENT from
  the preflight set (M1-809 item 2 negative half).
- P2 → M1-808 acceptance item 3: the captured download argv still carries
  `-u 0:0`, `-v <volume>:/models`, pinned image, no shell; 4b grep keeps
  `--retry 3 --create-dirs`; existing LlamacppWiringTest suite green.
  Mutation that drops `-u 0:0` or adds `--entrypoint sh` fails the item.
- P3 → M1-808 acceptance item 2: the 4-llm.sh and restore.sh download lines
  are flag-identical (dedupe probe); fixing one file only fails it.
- P4 → M1-808 reproduction test is RED on main and its assertion is only
  reachable through a RECORDED download argv — a shim that never issues the
  download fails loudly, not vacuously (§8 non-vacuity).
- P5 → M1-808 and M1-810 `security_relevant: true` (SECURITY check + redteam
  audit); M1-808 item 3 asserts argv-only pinned-image shape survives;
  M1-810 item 1 asserts no `network_mode` appears (runtime host networking
  stays out).
- P6 → M1-809 acceptance item 4 FAILURE-MODE (download guidance blaming
  "container DNS" or requiring daemon.json fails) + M1-810 acceptance item 5
  FAILURE-MODE (same discipline for build guidance).
- P7 → M1-808 grep probe: 4b download line keeps `--retry 3 --create-dirs`;
  fetch_gguf gains no retry flag.
- P8 → M1-808 argv assertion reads the name-only `-e` flags from the
  captured argv; `bash -n` green on all three scripts (set -u safe).
- P9 → M1-809 hermeticity item: every llamacpp-branch drive records a
  non-empty fake-curl argv log (proves interception; no real egress).
- P10 → M1-809 item 3: fake curl exit 22 → warn-and-continue; exits 6/7/28
  → abort with guidance.
- P11 → M1-810 item 2 (the host's compose v5.4.0 RENDERS the key — `docker
  compose config` proof) + item 6 (floor verification duty; conditional
  doctor gate with remedy; DoctorWiringTest green).
- P12 → M1-810 item 1 pins the comfyui OVERLAY's build block (the implicit
  fresh-GPU-host build) alongside the two app services; census rows for the
  implicit sites (4b-image.sh:801, apps.sh:65) dispose them to the same key.
- P13 → M1-810 item 5: guidance present at all four explicit sites
  (7-apps.sh, upgrade.sh step-4 AND rollback, restore.sh), honest text,
  exit codes/ordering unchanged (RestoreWiringTest green).

## Decomposition

Three tickets, ordered M1-808 → M1-809 → M1-810:

1. **M1-808 — Run wizard download containers on the host network**
   (blocked_by: []). The three download sites (4b-image.sh:594,
   4-llm.sh:230, restore.sh:232) gain `--network host` + name-only proxy-env
   forwarding; LlamacppWiringTest gains the argv pin and the shim extension
   that makes the download invocation observable (P4, pre-authorized for
   M1-809's consumption). security_relevant: true. Small: 3 scripts + 1 test
   class; the change per site is argument-level.
2. **M1-809 — Wizard download preflight parity and fail-fast guidance**
   (blocked_by: M1-808). 4-llm.sh gains the same-path preflight it lacks
   (generative always; embeddings when llamacpp-backed; P10 HEAD semantics);
   4b-image.sh/4-llm.sh/restore.sh gain actionable download-failure guidance
   (P6 honesty — host path, cause classes, proxy note; NO build claims, NO
   daemon-DNS-as-requirement pointer); restore.sh's printed manual-fetch
   recipe (:273-274) gains the same flags the scripts use; LlamacppWiringTest
   gains the fake-curl seam + the abort-before-download failure-mode test.
   security_relevant: false.
3. **M1-810 — Run wizard image builds on the host network**
   (blocked_by: M1-809). Declarative `build: network: host` in the three
   compose build blocks (covers the four explicit `compose build` sites AND
   the implicit up-time builds — P12); build-failure guidance at all four
   explicit sites (P13); compose-floor verification duty with conditional
   doctor version gate (P11); new static compose pin in the infochat-provider
   wiring package. security_relevant: true.

Fixtures are calibrated to the family END state: M1-808's argv pin
(`--network host` on the download line) is not touched by M1-809 (which adds
preflight + messages, never alters the download invocation) nor by M1-810
(compose files + build sites only); M1-809's download guidance makes no build
claim that M1-810's landing would falsify; M1-810's compose pins are additive
(no sibling touches the compose files). No ticket's test breaks a sibling.

**Family END state (change-note fact 3):** a first-time user on a divergent
host class runs ONLY the scripts — doctor → downloads (host path) → builds
(host path) → running deployment. Downloads are preflighted on the path they
use; builds need no preflight (the build IS the first use of the path, and
its failure guidance is honest). NO repo-launched container depends on
default-bridge DNS: downloads and builds are host-network; service containers
were never affected (compose embedded DNS forwards to the host stub —
verified). The daemon.json `"dns"` host remedy is optional residue for the
operator's own non-repo containers — not a setup-path requirement, and this
family deliberately does not document it in the setup path (§1: filing a
docs-only ticket for it is the user's call, not the family's end state).

**Not filed (disposed):** (a) daemon.json §7.8.7 documentation — optional
residue per the end state above (the draft's follow-up suggestion is
withdrawn under the change note); (b) the ollama-pull leg — verified
unaffected (change-note fact 1), no fix and no preflight (P1); (c) 4b
fetch_asset missing-checksum hazard — pre-existing, orthogonal to network
context, noted for the user (controls item 4).

## Prior art disposition

- **M1-798 (the crashing wizard):** carried — its item-6 preflight
  commitment is the direct ancestor of M1-809's; the defect is the unstated
  premise (host path ⇒ container path), not the implementation. Its round-1
  REWORK findings (picker honesty / licence label / conda number — ticket
  §Round 1 rework) are unrelated to the network surface: explicitly retired
  here with that citation.
- **M1-797:** carried as falsified precedent, now PROMOTED: the overlay's
  image was built with `--network=host` on this exact host for this exact
  reason (local memory entry; change-note fact 2 re-verified 2026-08-10).
  Option A derives the same mechanism from the wizard contract (the build
  legs are part of the §7.7.2 contracted path) rather than adopting the
  memory note wholesale; the note's "real fix = daemon.json" is Option B,
  rejected as THE fix and — under the change note — demoted from "residue
  remedy to document" to optional residue (end state above).
- **M1-744:** carried as family lineage — the rootless-trap class (host-side
  ACL remedy vs repo-side fix) and its redteam disposition of opt-in operator
  actions parallel P5's posture argument.
- **M1-442:** carried as P2/P4 — the volume-name pin and the shim-capture
  lesson are the direct test-shape precedents for M1-808's argv pin.
- **M1-394 + commits 5259fd73/cd194525:** carried as P2 — the fetch mechanics
  (argv-only, `-u 0:0`, SHA enforcement) any change to the download
  invocation must preserve (verified in current code, Ground truth).
- **M1-390:** carried as M1-809's posture ancestor and M1-810's doctor-floor
  shape ancestor — fail-loud, actionable remedy, never a silent pass.
- **Draft set on disk (this analysis v1 + M1-808/M1-809 v1):** revised per
  the change note — dispositions 1, 2 and discrepancy notes above record
  exactly what changed (restore.sh coverage error corrected; runtime
  ASSUMPTION replaced with verified facts; build legs promoted from
  follow-up to M1-810; guidance-text daemon-DNS pointer recalibrated to the
  end state).
- **Omissions this analysis surfaced (prior-art rule):** restore.sh:226-244
  (third download site), restore.sh:273-274 (printed manual recipe), the
  build legs incl. upgrade.sh:155 rollback rebuild and the implicit up-time
  builds (4b-image.sh:801, apps.sh:65) — none appears in the original brief's
